286: Cinergy 800e PVR (external) and 800i PVR (internal): the computer as a comfortable VCR

Precisely an important factor for the upcoming football world championship: No longer miss a match or a broadcast! With the Cinergy 800e PVR (external) or the Cinergy 800i PVR (internal) from TerraTec Electronic the computer advanced to an efficient and versatile VCR for analog television. The necessary video compression happens directly in the device, so the computer performance is not additionally troubled. The Cinergy 800e PVR will cost 169 euro, the Cinergy 800i PVR 109 euro and will be available end of May.

294: TerraTec Home Cinema - Powerful Software, Free for All TerraTec Cinergy Products

Computer-based video recording/ Multi-tuner support/ EPG It doesn’t get any more convenient and easier than this. Certainly far more convenient than conventional video recorders, the new TerraTec Home Cinema (THC) software, an efficient solution for viewing television at the computer, is available now. In combination with the popular Cinergy hardware (Stick, PCMCIA or installable TV solutions), the new THC covers the full range of TV applications. It turns the laptop or PC into a powerful video recorder with manual and remote-controlled (even via Internet or cell phone) recording functions.

301: TerraTec NOXON iRadio - WLAN-Audioplayer in „Retro” design for MP3s and Web Radio

Another design, but just as powerful. The NOXON family is increased with the launch of the NOXON iRadio at IFA: The new NOXON iRadio is a stand-alone radio perfect for the kitchen or other areas of the home. From the end of August the NOXON iRadio will be available for 199 Euro (299 CHF). The NOXON iradio utilises the popular characteristics of the brother NOXON 2 audio. Archive the music on the hard disk of the computer or listen to one of thousands of internet radio stations that can be available in every corner of the house.

303: Extraordinary Audio, Excellent Comfort: TerraTec’s New Surround Master 5.1 USB Headset with Six Separately Adjustable Speakers

A superior dynamic audio tool is about to hit the market! TerraTec Electronic is poised to launch a headset with six crystal-clear loudspeakers geared for gamers as well as Internet phone (Skype, VoIP) and standard users. As a very special feature, all six channels adjust individually. Whether competing online against others or playing alone, the sooner a gamer can hear and pinpoint the opponent, the faster and more effectively he or she can react. The USB2.0 headset will ship in October and retail for 59.99 euros (99 SFR).

Video converters are fast becoming a fixture in every well-stocked household. And with good reason: So much analogue video material is just waiting to be digitised. Fortunately, there are solutions out there.
